source.rule: Only requirements supported by the source are asserted as such. Where the source does not enumerate an exact checklist, the requirement is marked as not fully specified rather than invented.

chatbot_contract.official_submission_rule: Preparation and prevalidation are distinct from official submission. The chatbot must explicitly distinguish NOT_SUBMITTED from SUBMITTED.

electronic_signature.legally_permissible: Qualified electronic signature can have the same legal value as handwritten signature in covered cases.
electronic_signature.non_applicable: Certain authentic/legalized acts cannot be fully replaced.

electronic_data_exchange.legally_permissible: Electronic exchange/interoperability has a legal framework.
electronic_data_exchange.practice: Interoperability among APII/RNE/DGI/CNSS remains limited and often document/PDF/scan based.
electronic_data_exchange.non_applicable: Some sensitive datasets may not be exposable to third parties.

100_percent_online.legally_or_effectively_online: RNE has moved to fully digital operation; e-Jibaya/TEJ/CNSS teledeclaration are digital.
100_percent_online.practice: APII one-stop-shop, greffe, JORT and some CNSS steps remain partly physical.
100_percent_online.non_applicable: Some identity/token activation steps remain physical for security.
